caption: A saved prose baseline stays available across a restart.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['revision-session-marks']; p.modal?.close(); p.pro.signOut(); await p.discardSession(); p.state.named = []; p.settings = {baselineName:'First draft',author:'',includeSummary:false}; await p.saveSettings(); const f = app.vault.getFileByPath('Revision Session Marks/Workshop.md'); await p.startSession(f,await app.vault.read(f)); p.showSession(); document.querySelectorAll('.notice-container .notice').forEach(n => n.remove()); return 'ok'; })()
